parole.significato: board (committee that manages the business of an organization)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Koine Greek συμβούλιον (sumboúlion, “advice, counsel”), a Hellenistic semantic loan from Latin consilium. For sense "managing board", a free translation or semantic loan for the French conseil.
